doc: Known colour-doctrine debt the accent audit (dev/selftest/accent_audit.gd) tolerates: an accent ink on a layer palette.json does not allow it on (or, layer `cop`, vermilion on the cops: their accent is cop_blue since 2026-11-03), up to max_px at ppm px/m in the selftest junction (seed 91). Any offender not listed here, or above its max_px, fails the selftest evidence (tools/selftest/run.mjs). A row is debt, not a permission: it names the source and the lane that pays it off, and is deleted when the source is fixed.

rows.doc: measured 2026-11-03 at the int-day merge (junction 48 px/m: 4 px at stride 2, 7 px full res, all on a blood splat); the row goes when the audit compares a layer-hidden capture against a full capture of the same frame (or ignores gate-boundary flicker)
